name: Power Wash Crew
hook: Blast a filthy backyard clean. Ding at 100%!
how: Spray the fence, deck, car, gnome and playground until each one dings at 100%. The wide fan clears grime fast, but caked mud needs the turbo jet; clean the whole yard together for three stars.
controls: WASD to walk, hold the mouse on dirt to spray, Q or right-click to switch nozzle; touch: left thumb walks, touch dirt to spray, FAN/JET button
uses: The host's browser keeps every object's dirt, dings finished objects and runs the clock; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Everyone sees the same dirt wash away as anyone sprays: your own spray shows at once.
Bot washers pick a surface and sweep it row by row until enough people join.
The most grime each player blasted in one yard.
Make every nozzle stronger with no new deploy; an event's title shows on screen.
ideas: Add a soap nozzle that loosens caked mud so the fan can clear it
Hide a gold coin under the dirt on every object
Make it a pirate ship deck covered in barnacles
